summary: First-pass full-stack testing of Member & Transaction Intelligence. Backend: 30/30 pytest tests pass covering auth (all 3 roles, invalid, forgot-password generic, register admin-only), core endpoints (meta 24 members / 14 products / period 2024-01 to 2026-06, overview KPIs, matrix 24 rows, member detail, transactions summary + anti-double-counting rule verified: All=170.7M < Issuer+Acquirer, series/breakdown/table, Excel export), insights (7 comparison modes: mom/yoy/ytd/ytd_yoy/qoq/rolling/avg + waterfall/quadrant/heatmap), thresholds CRUD, saved views CRUD, role restriction (analyst blocked from admin routes, management can read), CSV import member flow (2 accepted / 1 rejected), transaction import rejects unknown member + negative volume, user create + new user login, audit log. Frontend: admin login shows full sidebar (10 nav items including Data Management, User Management, Audit Log, Pengaturan Threshold), user name 'Administrator' & role shown, data-freshness visible, Overview KPI cards + trend charts + donut + top-5 render, Matriks Mitra renders 24-row matrix with sticky columns and status badges, Rekap/Insights/Data/Threshold pages navigable, logout works. Analyst login: all 4 admin menus hidden and /users direct URL shows 'Akses Ditolak'. Management login: dashboard accessible and role label 'Management' shown. Forgot-password page loads.

minor.issue: Problem statement referred to mode 'YTD-vs-YTD' but backend/FE use id 'ytd_yoy'. Naming inconsistency only — functionally works. Test updated.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: expose ytd_vs_ytd as alias for ytd_yoy for consistency with problem statement wording.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_insights.list_views (line 246-249) queries saved_views twice — first query is unused/dead code. Minor cleanup.
routes_admin transaction volume parsing: complex float() expression at line 152 could mishandle European-style separators; consider using shared _num() helper used in commit.

auth.py send_password_reset_email logs raw reset link only when hostname is localhost; in preview env with EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY unset, emails silently fail (test only asserted generic response). Acceptable for internal app.
server.py CORS allow_origins uses env FRONTEND_URL — ensure production sets this correctly (currently allows credentials with wildcard-like origin list).
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 3 accounts (admin/analyst/management) verified working. Password login sets httpOnly access_token+refresh_token cookies (secure, samesite=none). Bcrypt hashes stored ($2b$ format).
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 24 members (MB001-MB024) + 14 products + 30 months trx on startup. Tests created (and persist) 2 imported test members TEST_M01/TEST_M02 (visible as Total Member=26 in UI) and a test analyst user test_new_analyst@mti.internal / TestPass123!.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py using pytest + parallel workers via pytest-xdist. Insights mode id is 'ytd_yoy' (not 'ytd_vs_ytd'). After running import tests, member count becomes 26 (2 TEST_ prefixed rows added). To reset: db.members.delete_many({member_code: /^TEST_/}) or rely on next agent creating a cleanup fixture. Auth uses httpOnly cookies; requests.Session persists them automatically. Curl needs -c/-b cookie jar.
